lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How long have you been studying Chinese?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 我才三个月。汉语很难，对不对？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cái sān gè yuè. Hànyǔ hěn nán, duì bu duì?
lines.english: Only three months. Chinese is hard, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 开始难，后来容易。你每天学几个小时？
lines.pinyin: Kāishǐ nán, hòulái róngyì. Nǐ měitiān xué jǐ gè xiǎoshí?
lines.english: Hard at first, easier later. How many hours do you study each day?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 一个小时。我听录音、写汉字。
lines.pinyin: Yī gè xiǎoshí. Wǒ tīng lùyīn, xiě Hànzì.
lines.english: One hour. I listen to recordings and write characters.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 很好的方法。多说、多听、多练习。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo de fāngfǎ. Duō shuō, duō tīng, duō liànxí.
lines.english: Good method. Speak more, listen more, practice more.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 谢谢你的建议。我们一起练习说汉语吧。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de jiànyì. Wǒmen yīqǐ liànxí shuō Hànyǔ ba.
lines.english: Thanks for the advice. Let's practice speaking Chinese together.
